scientific_question: On the already opened PoolFire p22-s01 condition, does any fixed five-of-nine camera subset provide a strict-safe Zero-CGLS K4 reference for all four frozen frames of each reported calibration, or is the v176 failure attributable to iteration depth, five-camera sensing, or a broader reference mismatch?
role: post-open mechanism and reference-capacity diagnostic on the same p22-s01 condition used by v176; truth is used only for offline capacity classification and cannot define a deployable selector

sealed_inputs.truth_transform: transpose each xyz frame to zyx, subtract the supported-interior mean, and zero the one-voxel outer boundary

frozen_operator.camera_order: canonical geometry order inherited from v169-v176
frozen_operator.forward: same exact-adjoint calibrated straight-ray density-gradient proxy as v176

ordered_diagnostic.primary: exhaust all 126 five-camera subsets with Zero-CGLS K4
ordered_diagnostic.depth_diagnostic: repeat the identical 126-subset roster with Zero-CGLS K8 using the same K8 trajectory and its K4 checkpoint
ordered_diagnostic.sensor_control: run all nine cameras with Zero-CGLS K4
ordered_diagnostic.cellwise_level: each calibration-frame may choose its own lowest canonical strict-safe subset; this is only an upper bound
ordered_diagnostic.calibration_shared_level: each calibration must use one subset fixed across all four frames; the lowest canonical all-frame strict-safe subset is the witness
ordered_diagnostic.unsafe_fallback: when no strict-safe witness exists, choose the lowest-index minimum normalized worst-metric subset for descriptive tails only; fallback choice never changes capacity classification
ordered_diagnostic.truth_access: allowed only for post-open offline scoring and witness classification

absolute_accuracy_gate.classification_rule: every selected cell must individually satisfy all three p90 limits; axis p90 and worst checks are additionally reported and must pass

exact_call_ledger.offline_truth_observation: one forward per calibration, subset, and frame plus one nine-camera forward per calibration and frame plus one reversed-order permutation-audit forward per calibration; excluded from logical deployment calls and reported separately
exact_call_ledger.geometry_operator_setup: reported separately from logical online calls
exact_call_ledger.resource_claim: none; exhaustive search wall time and memory are offline diagnostic costs

independent_recomputation.operator: independent calibrated ray clipping, row construction, exact adjoint, and camera subsetting
independent_recomputation.solver: independent CGLS recurrence with K4 and K8 checkpoints
independent_recomputation.classification: independently reconstruct every metric array, strict-safe mask, cellwise witnesses, calibration-shared witnesses, axis tails, and final decision
required_checks: 13 calibrations x 126 subsets x 4 frames x K4/K8
13 calibrations x 4 frames nine-camera K4 control
formal and independent metric arrays within tolerance
strict-safe masks and capacity classifications exactly equal
adjoint identity and camera permutation invariance

decision_order: Any identity, roster, truth-transform, operator, adjoint, permutation, solve, call-ledger, numeric, seal, or independent-recomputation failure makes v177 inconclusive.

If the calibration-shared five-camera K4 level passes 52/52 cells and 13/13 calibrations, conclude PASS_CALIBRATION_SHARED_FIVE_CAMERA_K4_REFERENCE_CAPACITY_V177. This is offline reference capacity only.

If calibration-shared K4 fails but cellwise K4 passes, conclude FAIL_CALIBRATION_SHARED_K4_WITH_CELLWISE_HEADROOM_V177 and attribute the gap to the fixed-across-frame dependency class rather than absent per-cell K4 capacity.
If K4 cellwise fails but calibration-shared K8 passes, conclude FAIL_K4_ITERATION_DEPTH_BOTTLENECK_V177. K8 does not preserve the K4 speedup premise.
If K4 cellwise and calibration-shared K8 fail but cellwise K8 passes, conclude FAIL_SHARED_K8_WITH_CELLWISE_K8_HEADROOM_V177.
If both five-camera K4 and K8 lack cellwise capacity but nine-camera K4 passes, conclude FAIL_FIVE_CAMERA_SENSING_CONDITIONING_CAPACITY_V177.
If nine-camera K4 also fails, conclude FAIL_BROADER_KRYLOV_REFERENCE_REPRESENTATION_V177; the mismatch is not attributable only to selecting five cameras.
stop_rule: v177 does not authorize a predictor, neural model, GPU, resource gate, or untouched test. A negative result closes the implicated reference shell and immediately redirects to the exact attribution above without tuning K, thresholds, subsets, or physics.
